title: Data Engineer Confirmed - Core Data Product(f/m/d)
description:
Data Engineer Confirmé.e

L'équipe Core Data Product de DECATHLON recherche ses futur-e-s Data Engineers basé·e·s à Lille/Paris.

 
Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons nos futur.es Data Engineers pour rejoindre les équipes Core Data Products.
Rejoignez l'équipe Core Data Products : Au cœur des décisions stratégiques de Decathlon
Au sein de notre Data Platform, vous évoluerez sur le socle qui alimente l'ensemble des décisions stratégiques et des modèles d'IA de Decathlon. Notre mission ? Construire la Single Source of Truth transversale pour transformer les données brutes en produits de données prêts à l'emploi (Gold layer), fiables et normés. Du design produit à la supply chain, en passant par l'éco-conception et l'expérience client, nos Core Data Products permettent à chaque équipe métier d'opérer avec agilité tout en propulsant des business models circulaires, rentables et responsables.
 
Ton futur terrain de jeu 


Les Core Data Products sont organisés en équipes expertes, chacune pilotée par un binôme Tech Lead & Product Manager. Selon ton profil et tes affinités, tu intégreras l’un de nos collectifs :
 
🔍 Équipe FOUNDATIONS
Relier les ressources de l'entreprise, sa santé financière et l'excellence opérationnelle.


🔍 Équipe PLANET & PRODUCT OFFER
Une source unique de vérité qui fait le lien entre la conception des produits et l'expérience de l'offre.
Mesurer l'impact de chaque décision sur l'humain et la planète pour propulser des modèles d'entreprise circulaires, rentables et responsables.


🔍 Équipe INDUSTRY SUPPLY INVENTORY
Unifier les données de la chaîne d'approvisionnement grâce à des produits de données prêts à évoluer à grande échelle. Alimenter Decathlon : du fournisseur jusqu'à la livraison.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Storage & Messaging
description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.
In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.
 About the Opportunity We are looking for a talented Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Storage and Messaging team in our established Platform Engineering team.
 We are an exchange. System scalability, performance and engineering productivity matter in everything that we do. Our platform domain is committed to fostering autonomy by providing engineering teams with paved paths to develop robust, secure, compliant, and scalable systems. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality
 What You’ll Be Doing Build a self-service platform that empowers teams to build at scale across diverse database and messaging technologies, enabling the seamless and reliable development of application and data products.
 Continuously evolve our platform to support new data models and use cases, including structured and semi-structured data models, stream processing, and data governance at scale .
 Build and maintain a secure, scalable, and compliant data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automation.
 Enable data ingestion, processing, and consumption at scale. All are offered entirely as self-service.
 Mentor teammates by sharing technical knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and driving engineering excellence.
 What We Look For Experience with one or more programming languages. We primarily use Golang and Python (Java is a plus), but we value problem-solving ability over syntax familiarity.

title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

We partner closely with Product Engineering to make sure upstream financial data is complete, reconciled and traceable.

 As the Staff Analytics Engineer on Finance Analytics, this person sets the technical direction for Coinbase's financial data layer and works side by side with Accounting, Controllership and FP&A. They need to understand how the books are closed, audited and controlled, not just how the data moves:
 Partner with Accounting and FP&A to support month-end and quarter-end close, building the datasets, reconciliations and reporting that let us close the books accurately and on time.
 Make financial data and pipelines audit-ready: SOX-compliant controls, lineage, change management and evidence for internal and external auditors.

title: Data Engineer, GTM Systems
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.
 This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.
 Key responsibilities
 Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape
 Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear
 Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness

title: Security Data Engineer
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.
 You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.
 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelin…
